Subtracting 260 days from 1887-11-10:  
1887 is not a leap year.  
260 days back from Nov 10:  
Oct (31 days) → Nov 10 to Oct 11 = 30 days back → 260 - 30 = 230 days left.  
Keep going back month by month through 1887 into 1886.  

From Oct 11, 1887:  
Sep (30) → Aug (31) → Jul (31) → Jun (30) → May (31) → Apr (30) → Mar (31) → Feb (28 in 1887) → Jan (31).  

Count:  
Oct 11 to Sep 11: 30 days (total 30)  
Sep 11 to Aug 11: 31 days (total 61)  
Aug 11 to Jul 11: 31 days (total 92)  
Jul 11 to Jun 11: 30 days (total 122)  
Jun 11 to May 11: 31 days (total 153)  
May 11 to Apr 11: 30 days (total 183)  
Apr 11 to Mar 11: 31 days (total 214)  
Mar 11 to Feb 11: 28 days (total 242)  
Feb 11 to Jan 11: 31 days (total 273) → overshoots 230 needed.  

We need 230 days back from Oct 11, 1887.  
From Oct 11 back to Jan 11 is 273 days, too many by 43 days.  
So go forward 43 days from Jan 11, 1887:  
Jan 11 + 20 days = Jan 31, 1887 (20 days used, 23 left)  
Feb 1 + 23 days = Feb 24, 1887.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1887-02-24
